text:
Ellen (Account Exec): Heads-up: ProtoSys wants to move from VendorX to Redwood. They need a quick POC for streaming chat + function-calls, plus security answers and a cost estimate. Theyre sensitive to JSON formatting differences in function outputs.

Ravi (SE): Got it. Do we have exact endpoints/features they use? Any custom headers or rate-limit behavior?

Ellen (Account Exec): Streaming tokens, function calls with strict JSON schema, embeddings for similarity, and a X-Client-Rate header they depend on.

Clara (Solutions Eng): We usually put a thin proxy to normalize requests/responses. That handles streaming framing and function-call naming differences. I can draft a minimal adapter.

Ravi (SE): Important: our streaming frames include metadata objects between chunks. We can emulate VendorXpartial-token frames at the proxy but it adds CPU overhead ~20-40ms per stream. Flag the perf hit in the BOM.

Clara (Solutions Eng): Example normalization rules Ill include in the repo: - map vendor function_name -> openai-style "name" field - enforce JSON schema with tolerant parsing - optional whitespace/order normalization for diffs

Noah (Security): For the questionnaire well need: SOC2 access, encryption at rest + in transit, KMS/HSM options, VPC peering, data retention & purge controls, plus incident contact. Also ask if they need on-prem or just VPC.

deploy-bot: Created repo redwood-pocs/protosys-migrate-1916001234 and added the team.

Ellen (Account Exec): Can we give a quick cost range? ProtoSys expects a number for budgeting today.

Clara (Solutions Eng): Quick estimate: POC on Hosted for 20k tokens/day ~ $1-1.5k/mo. For production with reserved concurrency/Dedicated, ballpark $12k-22k/mo depending on throughput and model. Will finalize after model choice + batch settings.

Ravi (SE): Plan for parity tests: 1) streaming truncation 2) malformed function args 3) high-latency bursts 4) embeddings similarity regression. Ill add a small test harness and a prompt set. ETA 5 business days.

Noah (Security): Ill assemble answers and request their legal for DPA. If they want SOC2 docs we provide a secure link. ETA 2 business days.

Clara (Solutions Eng): Action items: - Ravi: adapter + harness (5d) - Clara: BOM + perf notes (2d) - Noah: security Qs + DPA path (2d) - Ellen: customer contacts + kickoff schedule.

Ellen (Account Exec): Also include a rollback runbook if the POC shows behavior regression. We want automatic fallback to the old API and a canary threshold.

Ravi (SE): Will add a canary config: if function-call failure rate >3% or schema diff rate >1% over 1000 calls, trigger fallback to VendorX via proxy and alert oncall.

Clara (Solutions Eng): Ill include pricing for a short support window to assist rollback.

Ellen (Account Exec): Thanks team :thumbsup: Ill inform ProtoSys and set a kickoff for next Wed. Post updates in the repo.
